Between 0.25 and 0.35 — the harshest feature here: criminal statute used to arrest trans people on basis of gender expression (documented, with arrest counts in the hundreds for same-sex relations under wide discretion), police forcing a trans woman to display genitals, police doxxing. No documented custody sexual violence pattern, no organized sweeps specifically, no near-certain imprisonment.
